facts: Native end timestamp is recorded before checkpointing and plotting (pinned trainer lines1169-1193).
Author14 starts synchronized timer before superclass on_epoch_start, stops after superclass on_epoch_end and GPU synchronize (1092-1103).
Author14 calls save_every1 for SMOKE and10 for FULL (1198).
Adapter wraps checkpoint_latest/best/final saves in progress.publish; initial checkpoint before run_training; final checkpoint and actual validation occur outside epoch loop.
Progress.publish writes checkpoint, fsyncs, hashes, records and performs two commits (129-158).
Best checkpoint is also saved whenever native EMA improves, independent of periodic save_every.
limits: Difference combines logging, checkpoints, plotting, synchronization and boundary differences; it is not a measured checkpoint-only cost.
Native rounded time is not interchangeable with returned cost timing; genuine overall billed wall time also includes startup/validation/final writes.
Smoke uses a different periodic save frequency from FULL, so direct epoch extrapolation needs scientific author judgment.
Cannot establish warm-up plateau, all-arm timings, Sprint12 workload equivalence or an affordable full plan from this source audit.
